== Hiding In The Garbage physical printing correction ==
Correction to the earlier printing-source note: the archived Decipher white-border GIF is a digital rendition with a 1997 legal line. The newly checked physical white card has a 1999 legal line. Both faces print "Use your Force one by one"; the article and checklist had omitted "your". The new photograph documents the physical Revised face. The old publisher GIF, its File history and checked archive-byte evidence remain valid for the digital rendition. The complete source photograph is retained, and the new PNG only downsamples its full frame. No missing edge or printed content was reconstructed. Existing identities, family navigation and unrelated rulings are preserved.
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/sFcAAOSwpz9gtGKY/s-l1600.webp complete source photograph].
